---
name: Change request
about: One bounded change with observable acceptance criteria
---

## Behavior

What user or agent action should work differently?
Identify the deterministic scenario, Commons, Language lab or another affected area.

## Acceptance

A concrete input/action and expected result. State any important limits.

## Starting points

Relevant area from `npm run map`, existing helpers and contracts to preserve.

## Verification

Focused feedback command, full `npm run check`, and browser/provider checks if needed.
State any required local model or configuration without sharing credentials.
